entities.summary: Sofya Berultseva (b. 2000-11-06, Shymkent) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Shymkent and Kazakhstan. Known in the fields of kazakhstan, architects & designers, asia.
